name: Monkey D. Luffy
clues: A childhood promise becomes a voyage toward an impossible title.
Awakening turns this rubber fighter’s surroundings into a playful battlefield.
The straw-hatted captain fights in Gear Five and dreams of becoming Pirate King.
reasoning: Gear Five combines advanced Haki, elastic control and strong feats; duration, recovery costs and tactical inconsistency constrain the composite.

name: Roronoa Zoro
clues: A childhood vow keeps an impossible swordsmanship ambition alive.
A demanding blade draws out this fighter’s Haki during battles with elite opponents.
The green-haired Straw Hat swordsman fights with three swords and frequently gets lost.
reasoning: Conqueror-infused sword attacks offer concentrated offense; Enma’s Haki drain and narrower utility limit sustained overall performance.

name: Nami
clues: A stolen childhood is reclaimed by trusting a crew with an impossible burden.
Weather knowledge and a living thundercloud make this navigator dangerous at range.
The orange-haired Straw Hat navigator carries a Clima-Tact and draws sea charts.
reasoning: Zeus boosts weather offense and targeting; fragile close-range defense, limited endurance and reliance on equipment keep the overall score modest.

name: Usopp
clues: A frightened storyteller keeps choosing courage when escape would be easier.
Unusual plant ammunition turns a slingshot into a bag of battlefield tricks.
The long-nosed Straw Hat sniper once wore a mask as Sogeking.
reasoning: Creative sniping and Pop Green control reward preparation; inconsistent Observation Haki, low protection and limited direct output constrain the rating.

name: Sanji
clues: A promise to a rescued castaway shapes a lifelong search for a legendary sea.
Awakened bodily enhancements let this fighter sustain hotter flaming kicks.
The blond Straw Hat cook fights with his legs and seeks the All Blue.
reasoning: Ifrit Jambe, accelerated movement and awakened bodily resilience provide strong melee performance without stacking the destroyed Raid Suit.

name: Tony Tony Chopper
clues: An outcast inherits a doctor’s belief that caring can overcome isolation.
A medicine-assisted transformation trades a huge body for a difficult recovery.
The blue-nosed reindeer serves as the Straw Hat crew’s doctor.
reasoning: Monster Point adds size and strength; finite transformation time, recovery penalties and limited combat mobility offset medical support and flexible forms.

name: Nico Robin
clues: An erased homeland leaves forbidden history in the hands of a hunted survivor.
Sprouted limbs and giant grappling forms can attack from unexpected positions.
The Straw Hat archaeologist reads Poneglyphs and uses the Flower-Flower Fruit.
reasoning: Demonio Fleur and distributed grappling threaten exposed opponents; shared limb damage, stamina cost and ordinary bodily toughness limit broader performance.

name: Franky
clues: A shipwright’s guilt becomes a vow to build a vessel that reaches the world’s end.
Cola fuels this fighter’s mechanical body and experimental weapons.
The blue-haired Straw Hat cyborg builds ships and pilots a giant armored robot.
reasoning: General Franky armor and ranged weapons offer durable battlefield pressure; slow movement, cola reserves and vulnerable firing windows constrain the composite.

name: Brook
clues: A promise survives decades of solitude and a crew’s final song.
A returning soul brings chilling swordplay and unusual scouting options.
The Straw Hat skeleton musician hopes to reunite with Laboon.
reasoning: Soul scouting, freezing swordplay and musical disruption provide utility; modest direct offense and breakable bones prevent automatic immortality or soul victory.

name: Jinbe
signatureMoves: Fish-Man Karate: Five Thousand Brick Fist
Fish-Man Jujutsu: Ocean Current Shoulder Throw
clues: A promise of coexistence survives inherited hatred and divided loyalties.
This veteran transmits force through water and excels at close-range martial arts.
The whale shark fish-man helmsman joined the Straw Hats after leaving the Warlords.
reasoning: Fish-Man Karate, Haki and veteran composure support resilient close combat; water advantages depend on terrain and do not imply universal counters.

name: Portgas D. Ace
clues: A forbidden lineage leaves a young pirate searching for a reason to exist.
Flame techniques meet a darkness user’s unusual ability to draw opponents close.
The freckled commander of Whitebeard’s second division is the straw-hatted captain’s sworn brother.
reasoning: Fire Logia offense and battlefield reach are strong; Haki counters, demonstrated defeats and incomplete peak evidence limit defensive and composite estimates.

name: Sabo
clues: A noble-born child rejects the future assigned by his family.
An inherited flame ability complements crushing claw-shaped martial strikes.
The top-hatted Revolutionary Army chief of staff is a sworn brother of the straw-hatted captain.
reasoning: Dragon Claw techniques, Armament Haki and inherited fire powers provide balanced offense; sparse top-tier solo results keep the placement provisional.

name: Shanks
clues: A stolen fruit and a wager on the next generation reshape the seas.
Exceptional Haki lets this swordsman threaten opponents without a Devil Fruit.
The red-haired Emperor gave the future Pirate King his straw hat and lost an arm.
reasoning: Exceptional Haki and the demonstrated Kid strike support elite offense; limited prolonged fights leave durability, stamina and full arsenal uncertain.

name: Edward Newgate
clues: A legendary pirate values a chosen family more than treasure.
A bisento and a quake-producing fruit make this captain a strategic threat.
The crescent-mustached captain known as Whitebeard treated his crew as sons.
reasoning: Demonstrated Roger-era Haki and quake combat support strategic strength; limited prime scenes leave detailed stamina and peak calibration uncertain.

name: Marshall D. Teach
clues: A patient opportunist turns betrayal into a path toward an impossible prize.
Two Devil Fruit powers combine gravity-like darkness with destructive quakes.
The pirate called Blackbeard captured the fire commander and commands the Blackbeard Pirates.
reasoning: Darkness contact suppression and quake offense create major threats; heightened pain, limited speed feats and unknown acquisition mechanics constrain confident peak scaling.

name: Kaido
clues: A captive warrior builds a kingdom around strength and a promised great war.
Dragon transformations and a heavy club accompany extraordinary endurance.
The horned Emperor of the Beasts Pirates ruled Wano from Onigashima.
reasoning: Dragon forms, advanced Haki and repeated sustained fights support elite pressure; final flame coating is temporary and does not grant limitless invulnerability.

name: Charlotte Linlin
clues: A dream of shared meals becomes a coercive kingdom of uneasy families.
Soul-created companions supply fire, lightning and an animated blade.
The Emperor called Big Mom commands the sweet-themed pirates of Totto Land.
reasoning: Soul-enhanced strength, homies and exceptional toughness create broad threats; lifespan expenditure, fear conditions and inconsistent tactics limit the composite.

name: Charlotte Katakuri
clues: An older sibling hides a personal insecurity behind an untouchable reputation.
Calm observation and a reshapeable body help this fighter avoid incoming strikes.
Big Mom’s scarf-wearing Sweet Commander battles with awakened mochi.
reasoning: Future sight and awakened mochi reward composure; finite endurance, emotional disruption and lower raw output constrain elite defensive advantages.

name: King
clues: A surviving prisoner finds purpose beside a captain promising to change the world.
A back flame marks a tradeoff between extraordinary protection and faster movement.
The masked Lunarian commander of the Beasts Pirates transforms into a pteranodon.
reasoning: Lunarian protection and airborne Zoan offense are formidable; flame-state speed tradeoffs and demonstrated defeat prevent simultaneous maximum speed and defense.

name: Queen
clues: A former research colleague hides cruel experiments behind a flamboyant stage act.
Mechanical enhancements mix a dinosaur body with copied scientific weapons.
The cigar-smoking Beasts Pirates commander dances and transforms into a brachiosaurus.
reasoning: Cyborg weapons and ancient Zoan resilience add breadth; slower execution, tactical mistakes and limited top-tier results constrain sustained combat effectiveness.

name: Donquixote Doflamingo
clues: A discarded noble turns a family grievance into a criminal empire.
Awakened threads transform terrain and restrain vulnerable opponents.
The pink-feather-coated former Warlord ruled Dressrosa with the String-String Fruit.
reasoning: Awakened strings, control and tactical creativity raise utility; limited output against later elites and concentration-dependent effects constrain broader scaling.

name: Crocodile
clues: A failed dream becomes a plan to seize an ancient weapon through a stolen kingdom.
Dry sand and a hidden poisoned hook reward prepared battlefield control.
The scar-faced former Warlord with a golden hook once led Baroque Works.
reasoning: Sand control, dehydration and preparation create dangerous openings; moisture counters and sparse recent combat evidence prevent reputation-based post-timeskip inflation.

name: Rob Lucci
clues: An undercover craftsman treats violence as an instrument of official justice.
An awakened leopard body augments a practiced six-style martial toolkit.
The pigeon-accompanied Cipher Pol assassin once infiltrated Water Seven.
reasoning: Awakened leopard recovery, Haki and Rokushiki deliver sharp melee pressure; clear defeats and narrower control options bound the composite.

name: Enel
clues: A self-styled divinity seeks a distant land beyond the sky.
Electrical senses extend observation, but one unusual body defeats the expected matchup.
The long-eared lightning ruler of Skypiea carries a staff and a drum ring.
reasoning: Lightning reach and observation are potent; vulnerable reactions, modest bodily resilience and the rubber matchup constrain assumed destructive superiority.

name: Trafalgar D. Water Law
clues: A rescued child carries a quiet memorial in the name of his crew.
Spatial surgery and awakening trade exceptional control for demanding stamina costs.
The tattooed Heart Pirates captain wields Kikoku and the Op-Op Fruit.
reasoning: Awakened internal attacks and spatial control offer exceptional utility; heavy stamina costs and strong-Haki resistance prevent unrestricted instant-win surgery.

name: Eustass Kid
clues: A ruthless rival refuses to surrender his ambition after losing an arm.
Awakened magnetism turns available metal and assigned poles into heavy weapons.
The red-haired Kid Pirates captain builds a mechanical arm from scrap.
reasoning: Awakened magnetism and railgun offense create heavy pressure; metal supply, charge time and limited defensive reactions constrain sustained effectiveness.

name: Killer
clues: A loyal partner keeps fighting after a cruel failed experiment steals his natural expression.
Spinning forearm blades produce attacks that challenge ordinary outer defenses.
The masked blond fighter serves beside the red-haired scrap-metal captain.
reasoning: Punisher blades, mobility and sonic strikes threaten exposed targets; limited range, protection and sustained elite feats restrict the overall profile.

name: Boa Hancock
clues: A former captive guards an island while hiding a brand that shaped her life.
A heart-shaped gesture and petrifying strikes punish vulnerable opponents.
The Snake Princess leads the Kuja Pirates and rules Amazon Lily.
reasoning: Petrification and Haki-backed kicks provide dangerous pressure; susceptibility conditions, direct grabs and sparse extended battles limit confident peak scaling.

name: Bartholomew Kuma
clues: A gentle protector accepts a terrible bargain to save a child.
Paw-shaped palms repel attacks, people and extracted suffering.
The large Bible-carrying former Warlord secretly protected the Straw Hats’ ship.
reasoning: Paw repulsion and cyborg toughness create exceptional control; injury, commitment costs and incomplete peak evidence bound seemingly absolute displacement effects.

name: Dracule Mihawk
clues: A lonely master finds a future rival in a swordsman unwilling to abandon his vow.
A great black blade sends destructive cuts across distant terrain.
The hawk-eyed swordsman carries Yoru and trained the green-haired Straw Hat.
reasoning: Demonstrated black-blade attacks and mastery support high offense; sparse unrestricted fights leave full speed, stamina and peak placement uncertain.
